name: harmonic_pattern_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional algorithmic orders (FII/DII TWAP execution, momentum algo tranches) decompose large directional positions into two structured legs, creating measurable AB=CD wave patterns at the 30-second to 10-minute scale. When NIFTY's CD leg completes at 1.0x or 1.272x the AB length — the Fibonacci extension point where the algo's second participation tranche exhausts — a sharp contra-move of 10-25 spot points occurs within the first 15-90 seconds as resting limit orders clustered at the Fibonacci level absorb the exhausted flow. The BC retracement (38-88% of AB) confirms genuine institutional wave structure rather than random noise, because market-maker hedging during the BC phase is the mechanism that 'loads the spring' for the CD extension. At 5-second resolution, the D-pivot confirmation (available 30 seconds after the actual turning point) allows entry at the very start of the reversal, capturing 50-70% of the initial snap-back before new directional flow resumes.
core_signal_oneliner: ABCD harmonic pattern completion at Fibonacci extension D-pivot with 30-second confirmation
